about: Reserve the business name that identifies an establishment and its trade dealings.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: Decision of the company's authorised body approving the branch and the representative's authorisation
No-objection letter from the free zone to licence a branch
Undertaking that the company will have no other branch in Abu Dhabi
Embassy and Foreign Ministry attested certificate, translated into Arabic, with legal form, licence name, owners, capital and incorporation date
timing: You get an approval or rejection notice, then pay if approved
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
